text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see that operating claw machines is no
easy
feat...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't pay it any mind. After that
selfish
request, I'm the one who ought to
be apologizing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've not had many opportunities
to visit
establishments like these. I had
fun just watching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A desired item being both right in front
of you
and out of reach... What a novel
experience. I
expect that aspect only
adds to the claw
machine's allure.
